title: Time schedule — params
description: At a clock time on given days (in a timezone) switch to a named GPU layout. Target selector is ignored for this type (the layout defines targets). Optional prefetch warms caches ahead of the switch.

cron.title: Cron (advanced)
cron.description: 5-field cron expression; when set it replaces at/days.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Default from env RULES_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.

prefetch_minutes_before.title: Prefetch models (minutes before)
prefetch_minutes_before.description: Issue prefetch_model + pin for every model the layout needs this long before the switch.

catch_up.title: Catch up missed runs
catch_up.description: If the jobs process was down at the scheduled time, apply the layout on start-up when the next run is more than 1 h away.
